title: Readiness coverage summary sub-view (FBS-205, TAC-4135)
description: renderCoverageSummary + computeCoverageSummary + familyCounts. Reads coverage.tree.totals.{requirements,covered,coveredUnresolved,uncovered} and unresolvedTestPointers[] plus the tree model to render stat line, stacked bar on --sv-success/--sv-warning/--sv-danger over --sv-surface, six family stat tiles, and an unresolved-pointers table. Every slot renders a number or the words 'coverage unavailable' - never a blank. Replaces the retired renderCoverage block that printed pass/total blanks.
